title: Classification and Exact Local Masking in Finite-Field Clifford Dual-Unitary Circuits
summary: We classify two-qudit Clifford dual-unitary gates over the finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$, where the local dimension $q$ is a prime power, and apply the classification to exact local masking and operator transport in homogeneous brickwork circuits. Under ordered one-qudit Clifford equivalence, the dual-unitary locus contains $q-2$ perfect-tensor cores, one rank-one core, and one SWAP core. Homogeneous repetition separates these cores into five distinct transport phases. The one-site Weyl edge channels determine exact local-masking distances.
